title: Peec AI Alternatives 2026: 10 Tools Compared on Price
excerpt: Compare 10 Peec AI alternatives on price, AI engines, trials and white label, plus Peec AI pricing for 2026 and who should stay with Peec instead of switching.
author: AI Brand Track Team
content:
The best Peec AI alternatives are [Otterly.AI](https://otterly.ai/pricing) (from $29/mo) if you want a cheaper daily tracker with Google AI Overviews, [Rankscale](https://rankscale.ai/pricing) (from $17/mo billed yearly) or [LLMrefs](https://llmrefs.com/pricing) ($79/mo) if you want more engines without paying per model, and [Scrunch](https://scrunch.com/pricing), [AthenaHQ](https://www.athenahq.ai/pricing) or [Profound](https://www.tryprofound.com/pricing) if you need enterprise depth. Peec AI itself costs $95, $245 or $495 a month on monthly billing, according to [PricingSaaS](https://pricingsaas.com/companies/peec), and third-party reviews say each self-serve plan lets you choose 3 models ([Rework](https://resources.rework.com/tools/aeo-ai-visibility/best-peec-ai-alternatives)).

*Prices checked on October 27, 2026; vendors change prices often. Each price links to the vendor's own pricing page unless we say otherwise.*

**Disclosure:** AI Brand Track is our product and is one of the alternatives below. We've described its limitations as plainly as everyone else's.

## What is Peec AI?

Peec AI is an AI search analytics platform for marketing and SEO teams. It tracks a set of prompts on AI models and reports visibility, position, sentiment and share of voice against competitors, plus the sources AI answers cite. Its [pricing page](https://peec.ai/pricing) groups features into Discover (prompt volume and intent), Measure (visibility tracked daily, AI shopping), Act (gap analysis, recommended actions) and Report (crawlability audit, AI referrals, automated reporting), plus a "Peec agent."

Peec says on its pricing page that it is trusted by "3500+ brands and agencies." The [agency page](https://peec.ai/for-agencies) offers free 7-day pitch projects for prospects, unlimited client seats, a Looker Studio template you can brand per client, and read-only dashboard links for clients.

## Peec AI pricing in October 2026

[Peec's pricing page](https://peec.ai/pricing) lists Starter, Pro, Advanced (monthly) and Enterprise (custom, annual). Its prices load in the browser and weren't readable by our text-based check, so we used [PricingSaaS](https://pricingsaas.com/companies/peec), which recorded them from Peec's page on October 26, 2026:

| Plan | Monthly billing | Annual billing (per month) | Prompts (reported) | Extra model |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter | $95 | $80 | 50 | $35/mo |
| Pro | $245 | $205 | 150 | $85/mo |
| Advanced | $495 | $420 | 350 | $165/mo |
| Enterprise | Custom | Custom | Custom | Up to 13 models |

Prompt limits and the 3-model limit come from third-party reviews ([Rework](https://resources.rework.com/tools/aeo-ai-visibility/best-peec-ai-alternatives), updated October 2, 2026), not from a page we could read on Peec's site. [Agency plans](https://peec.ai/for-agencies) are sold by credits (Essential 10,000, Growth 25,000, Scale 65,000, Comprehensive unlimited) with no published prices.

Peec's pricing page lists no free plan and doesn't mention a free trial. [Dupple](https://dupple.com/learn/peec-ai-review), a review site, reports "a one-week free trial with no credit card required" (updated September 17, 2026), but other listings disagree on the card requirement, and we couldn't confirm the terms on a Peec page.

For every vendor's prices side by side, see our [AI visibility tool pricing](/blog/ai-visibility-tool-pricing) comparison.

## Why teams look for Peec AI alternatives

Peec is a solid tool, and many teams are happy with it. The reasons people look elsewhere are usually specific:

- **Model limits.** Self-serve plans reportedly track 3 models ([Rework](https://resources.rework.com/tools/aeo-ai-visibility/best-peec-ai-alternatives)); a fourth costs $35 to $165/mo depending on the plan ([PricingSaaS](https://pricingsaas.com/companies/peec)). If you need ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and AI Overviews, that adds up.
- **Prompt caps.** 50 prompts on Starter is enough for one focused brand, but not for several product lines.
- **Agency pricing.** Agency plans are sold by credits, and their prices aren't published.
- **API access.** API and SSO are reportedly Enterprise features ([Rework](https://resources.rework.com/tools/aeo-ai-visibility/best-peec-ai-alternatives)).
- **No white-label portal.** Peec's [agency page](https://peec.ai/for-agencies) describes branding through Looker Studio dashboards, not a client portal on your own domain.

## Who should stay with Peec AI

Stay with Peec if daily tracking of 3 models covers the engines your buyers use, you value its source and perception reporting, or you're an agency that benefits from credit-based plans, pitch projects and unlimited client seats rather than per-client pricing.

## The 10 best Peec AI alternatives

### 1. Otterly.AI

**Price:** [Lite](https://otterly.ai/pricing) $29/mo ($25 annually, 15 prompts); Standard $189/mo (100 prompts); Premium $489/mo (400 prompts).

- **Strengths:** a much lower entry price than Peec, Google AI Overviews and Copilot on every plan, API and MCP from Standard, and agency partner benefits such as pitch workspaces. The [trial](https://help.otterly.ai/free-trial?hsLang=en) is 7 days with no card.
- **Weaknesses:** 15 prompts on Lite. Gemini, AI Mode and Claude are add-ons, so the real price depends on which engines you need.
- **Best for:** small teams that care most about Google's AI answers.

### 2. Rankscale

**Price:** [Essentials](https://rankscale.ai/pricing) $17/mo (yearly only, 120 credits, 2 brands); Pro $99/mo ($84 yearly, 1,200 credits, 10 brands); Growth $385/mo.

- **Strengths:** 17+ engines on every plan, so no per-model fees. Credit rollover from Pro and white-label options on Growth.
- **Weaknesses:** credit maths takes some getting used to ("typically 0.25 credits per engine per prompt"). The REST API starts on Pro+ ($229/mo).
- **Best for:** teams that left Peec because of the 3-model limit.

### 3. LLMrefs

**Price:** [All in One](https://llmrefs.com/pricing) $79/mo ("limited time").

- **Strengths:** 500 prompts and all listed engines, including Claude, with no add-on fees. Unlimited projects and team members, CSV export and API, 7-day trial.
- **Weaknesses:** weekly refresh rather than daily, and keyword-based tracking instead of hand-written prompts.
- **Best for:** teams that want breadth and volume on one simple bill.

### 4. LLM Pulse

**Price:** [Starter](https://llmpulse.ai/pricing) €49/mo weekly or €79/mo daily (50 prompts, 1 project), up to Partner++ at €3,799/mo.

- **Strengths:** every price except Enterprise is public, MCP on every plan, and API plus Looker Studio from Scale. The 14-day trial on weekly plans needs a payment method.
- **Weaknesses:** five engines included; Claude, Copilot and others cost from €8/mo per model. White label is Enterprise-only in the comparison table, though the agency section mentions it on Partner plans.
- **Best for:** European teams that want public euro pricing and a choice of weekly or daily runs.

### 5. Trakkr

**Price:** [Growth](https://www.trakkr.ai/pricing) $100/mo ($83 annually) for 1 brand; Scale $500/mo for 10 brands.

- **Strengths:** 8 engines checked daily on every plan, a 14-day trial, and white-label portals included on Scale.
- **Weaknesses:** 1 brand on Growth; extra brands cost $50/mo each.
- **Best for:** agencies that want a published white-label price.

### 6. Rank Prompt

**Price:** [Free](https://rankprompt.com/pricing) (10 credits, one report, no card); Starter $39/mo billed annually; Agency $119/mo and Agency Plus $239/mo billed annually.

- **Strengths:** 6 engines on every plan, a free plan with no time limit, and white-label options from Agency, including your own domain and client logins on Agency Plus.
- **Weaknesses:** headline prices are annual-billing rates; the FAQ and [white-label page](https://rankprompt.com/white-label) quote $149 and $299 a month for the agency plans, which match the monthly prices implied by the page's savings figures. Client logins are read-only.
- **Best for:** freelancers and small agencies starting on a tight budget.

### 7. Scrunch

**Price:** [Starter](https://scrunch.com/pricing) $300/mo ($250 billed annually); Growth $500/mo ($417); Enterprise custom.

- **Strengths:** 350 custom prompts plus 1,000 industry prompts on Starter, personas, page audits and agent traffic monitoring. 7-day trial, no card.
- **Weaknesses:** 3 seats on Starter, and the Enterprise Data API and SAML/OIDC SSO are Enterprise-only.
- **Best for:** mid-market teams that outgrew Peec's prompt caps.

### 8. AthenaHQ

**Price:** [Essential](https://www.athenahq.ai/pricing) free (300 credits, 5 engines); Starter $295/mo (3,600 credits, 11 models).

- **Strengths:** a permanent free plan, and 11 models on Starter including Claude, Grok, DeepSeek and Mistral. Content actions and a content optimization agent.
- **Weaknesses:** API and extra credits are unpriced add-ons on Starter.
- **Best for:** teams that want many models plus content work in one place.

### 9. Profound

**Price:** [free trial](https://www.tryprofound.com/pricing) (50 prompts daily for 7 days on 3 engines); Enterprise custom.

- **Strengths:** conversation-based prompt volume data, Agent Analytics for AI crawlers, up to 9 engines, API and SSO.
- **Weaknesses:** no published self-serve price. See our [Profound alternatives](/blog/profound-alternatives) guide for the background.
- **Best for:** enterprises with budget for a custom contract.

### 10. AI Brand Track

*AI Brand Track is our product.*

**Price:** 14-day Starter trial for $9 (card required), with 1 full analysis plus automatic weekly checks of 1 brand and a weekly email. Not happy during your 14 days? We refund your $9 (the trial fee). Then Starter $39/mo (53 credits; one full analysis uses 11), Pro $69/mo (154 credits), or pay-as-you-go: $49 for 53 credits or $149 for 220 credits that never expire. All prices are public on [/plans](/plans).

- **Strengths:** ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini included in every plan, so there's no model add-on to budget for. Weekly monitoring with a trend graph and weekly email, competitor benchmarking, share of voice, sentiment, source and citation tracking, CSV/JSON export, and Boost actions that generate content fixes.
- **Weaknesses:** no Google AI Overviews, AI Mode or Copilot tracking. No white label, client portal, PDF reports, daily tracking or API yet. Peec's daily runs and agency tooling go further than ours today.
- **Best for:** teams that want the four main assistants covered at a published price, with Boost content fixes built in. See how the [AI rank tracker](/ai-rank-tracker) works.

## How to choose a Peec AI alternative

1. **Start from the engines you need.** If Peec's 3 models are the problem, Rankscale, LLMrefs, Trakkr, Rank Prompt and AI Brand Track include Claude without an add-on.
2. **Check frequency.** Peec tracks daily. Otterly.AI, Trakkr and Geoptie run daily too; LLMrefs and AI Brand Track run weekly; LLM Pulse lets you choose.
3. **Compare on prompts × engines × runs**, not headline price. Our [pricing guide](/blog/ai-visibility-tool-pricing) shows where add-ons and annual-only billing change the total.
4. **Agencies: check white label and per-client cost.** Peec sells agency plans by credits with unlimited client seats. Trakkr, Rank Prompt and Rankscale publish white-label prices; most enterprise tools don't.

## FAQ

### How much does Peec AI cost?

According to [PricingSaaS](https://pricingsaas.com/companies/peec), which recorded Peec's page on October 26, 2026, Starter costs $95/mo, Pro $245/mo and Advanced $495/mo on monthly billing, or $80, $205 and $420 a month billed annually. Enterprise is custom. Peec's prices load in the browser, so we cite PricingSaaS rather than a direct read.

### Is Peec AI free?

No. Peec AI's pricing page lists no free plan and doesn't mention a trial; [Dupple](https://dupple.com/learn/peec-ai-review) reports a one-week free trial with no card required, which we couldn't confirm on a Peec page. If you want a free plan, [AthenaHQ](https://www.athenahq.ai/pricing) and [Rank Prompt](https://rankprompt.com/pricing) have one.

### How many AI models does Peec AI track?

Self-serve plans reportedly let you choose 3 models, according to third-party reviews such as [Rework](https://resources.rework.com/tools/aeo-ai-visibility/best-peec-ai-alternatives). Extra models are add-ons, and Enterprise tracks up to 13 ([PricingSaaS](https://pricingsaas.com/companies/peec)).

### What is the cheapest Peec AI alternative?

The lowest published paid entry we found is [Rankscale Essentials](https://rankscale.ai/pricing) at $17/mo, billed yearly. [Otterly.AI Lite](https://otterly.ai/pricing) is $29/mo, and [Rank Prompt](https://rankprompt.com/pricing) has a free plan.

### Which Peec AI alternative tracks the most engines?

[Rankscale](https://rankscale.ai/pricing) lists 17+ engines on every plan, [AthenaHQ Starter](https://www.athenahq.ai/pricing) covers 11 models and [LLMrefs](https://llmrefs.com/pricing) covers 9 or more with no extra fees.

### Does Peec AI offer white label?

Peec's [agency page](https://peec.ai/for-agencies) describes branded Looker Studio dashboards and read-only links for clients, but not a white-label portal on your own domain. [Trakkr](https://www.trakkr.ai/pricing), [Rank Prompt](https://rankprompt.com/pricing) and [Rankscale](https://rankscale.ai/pricing) publish white-label prices. AI Brand Track does not offer white label yet.

### Is AI Brand Track a good Peec AI alternative?

It is if you want ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini included in every plan, weekly monitoring and content fixes at a published price. It isn't if you need daily tracking, Google AI Overviews, an API or agency features. You can [start a 14-day trial for $9](/plans?checkout=starter-monthly) and compare it with your current Peec data.
